---
title: "Prepare the reading lists"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
manual:
  page: 12
---

The reading sections use the website's YAML data shape. The BibTeX files are
the editable source; the YAML files are the handoff to the rendered newsletter.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm the bibliographies"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
command -v pandoc
test -s _data/newsletter/articles.bib
test -s _data/newsletter/blogs.bib
test -s _data/newsletter/media.bib
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Convert the reading lists"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
pandoc _data/newsletter/articles.bib -s -f biblatex -t gfm > _data/newsletter/articles.yml
pandoc _data/newsletter/blogs.bib -s -f biblatex -t gfm > _data/newsletter/blogs.yml
pandoc _data/newsletter/media.bib -s -f biblatex -t gfm > _data/newsletter/media.yml
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="The reference handoff is readable"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -s _data/newsletter/articles.yml
test -s _data/newsletter/blogs.yml
test -s _data/newsletter/media.yml
head -n 2 _data/newsletter/articles.yml
```

:::
